name: Sanjukta Dash

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sanjukta Dash writes poetry in Odia and English. Her Odia collections include Antaswara, Amruta Anwesha, Apekshare Ebe Bi and Bou. Her English books include Lockdown Lyrics, published by Authorspress, and A Spark that Speaks, published by Black Eagle Books in 2026. Together, these titles trace a sustained bilingual writing life.

In “If Bullets shot Flowers”, she imagines ammunition becoming petals and battlefields becoming gardens. The poem returns to this transformation as it moves from wounded earth towards coexistence and compassion. Its hopeful argument rests on a simple reversal: what is made to harm might instead become a gift.
